meta.name: MemeTracker
meta.shortDescription: Track Dogecoin payments to an address (mempool)
meta.longDescription: MemeTracker is a Go-based Dogecoin mempool tracker. Call GET /track/<address> to start monitoring a P2PKH payout address. It returns the recent tracked transactions stored in the tracker DB (limited by config). Tracking addresses are retained for a configurable number of days after the last time they were requested; after that they are removed along with their stored transactions.

sections.name: Web API
sections.description: HTTP API for starting/stopping tracking and reading transactions

fields.name: LIST_LIMIT
fields.label: Max recent transactions to return per address

sections.name: Tracking Retention
sections.description: How long to keep an address and its transactions after last request

fields.name: P2P_HOST
fields.label: Optional P2P peer host override (empty = DNS seeds)
